title: Cellular filtration of a representative of a derived module object
statement: For a commutative ring R of universe u and a derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of modules with carrier universe max(u,v), every object K admits a representative L with K isomorphic to Q(L) and a sequence F_n of cochain complexes, inclusions i_n:F_n→L and steps s_n:F_n→F_{n+1}. The object Q(F_0) is zero, each i_n is monic, s_n followed by i_{n+1} equals i_n, and every element of every degree of L lies in an F_n. For every n there is a set I in the module universe, integers d_i, a coproduct G_n of the shifts (R[0])[d_i], and a distinguished triangle G_n→Q(F_n)→Q(F_{n+1})→G_n[1]. The free rank-one module is ULift R in the stated carrier universe.

proof.text: Choose M=Q.objPreimage K and apply [lem-pc-large-filtered-free-resolution]. Take its L, filtration, inclusions and steps. Map the zero initial object through Q. Invert Q(q), using its quasi-isomorphism instance, and compose with the inverse of Q.objObjPreimageIso K to obtain K≅Q(L).

For each n, monicity of the inclusion iota_n and step compatibility imply that step_n is monic (mono_of_mono_fac). Form the short exact cokernel sequence of step_n. Use [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] and inverse rotation to give the triangle with first vertex Q(cokernel(step_n))[-1]. Apply [lem-pc-derived-shifted-free-coproduct] to the resolution quotient isomorphism, and use its coprojections on that first vertex. The rotated triangle maps give the required a,b,c.
